non_blocking_notes: F1 target (0.55) is reported but treated as non-blocking: at a 20% base rate and recall >= 0.65, F1 is bounded by precision; the committee decides whether to revise it.
The 95th-percentile check shows how often a single month's randomised decisions could exceed the limit by chance; it is reported to the committee rather than blocking.
